<translated_code>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class G{
public:
    static constexpr int gmax = INT_MAX / 100;
    struct Edge {
        int u, flow, rid, cost;
        Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d) : u(a), flow(b), rid(c), cost(d) {}
    };
    class MinCostMaxFlow{
    public:
        vector<vector<Edge>> al;
        vector<vector<Edge>> ja;
        vector<int> d; // shortest distances
        int N, S, T, maxFlow; 
        long long minCost;
        int edges = 0;

        vector<int> node, visit, prv, prve, dist;

        MinCostMaxFlow(int n, int source, int sink) {
            N=n; S=source; T=sink; maxFlow=0; minCost=0;
            al.resize(N);
            d.resize(N);
            for(int i=0; i<N; i++) al[i] = vector<Edge>();
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost){
            int lu = (int)al[u].size(), lv = (int)al[v].size();
            al[u].push_back(Edge(v, flow, cost, lv));
            al[v].push_back(Edge(u, 0, -cost, lu));
        }

        void convertToArray() {
            ja.resize(N);
            for(int i=0; i<N; i++){
                ja[i] = al[i];
                al[i].clear();
            }
        }

        bool BellmanFord(bool check) {
            fill(d.begin(), d.end(), gmax);
            d[0] = 0;
            for(int i=0; i<N-1; i++){
                for(int j=0; j<N; j++){
                    for(auto &e: ja[j]){
                        if(e.flow==0) continue;
                        if(d[j]+e.cost<d[e.u]) d[e.u]=d[j]+e.cost;
                    }
                }
            }
            if(check){
                for(int j=0; j<N; j++){
                    for(auto &e: ja[j]){
                        if(e.flow==0) continue;
                        if(d[j]+e.cost<d[e.u]) return false;
                    }
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        bool simple() {
            node.resize(N); visit.resize(N); prv.resize(N); prve.resize(N); dist.resize(N);
            std::fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), gmax);
            node[0]=S; dist[0]=0;
            int front=1, back=0;
            while(front!=back){
                int u=node[back++]; int distu=dist[u];
                if(back==N) back=0;
                visit[u]=2;
                for(int i=0; i<(int)ja[u].size(); i++){
                    auto &e=ja[u][i];
                    if(e.flow==0) continue;
                    int cdist=distu+e.cost;
                    if(cdist<dist[e.u]){
                        if(visit[e.u]==0){
                            node[front]=e.u;
                            if(++front==N) front=0;
                        } else if(visit[e.u]==2){
                            if(--back==-1) back+=N;
                            node[back]=e.u;
                        }
                        visit[e.u]=1;
                        prve[e.u]=i; prv[e.u]=u; dist[e.u]=cdist;
                    }
                }
            }
            return visit[T]!=0;
        }

        struct pair {
            int F; int S;
            pair(int a, int b) : F(a), S(b) {}
            bool operator<(const pair &other) const {
                return S>other.S; // reverse order for min-heap
            }
        };

        bool dijkstra() {
            fill(visit.begin(), visit.end(),0);
            fill(prv.begin(), prv.end(),0);
            fill(prve.begin(), prve.end(),0);
            fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), gmax);
            std::priority_queue<pair> pq;
            pq.push(pair(S,0));
            dist[S]=0;
            while(!pq.empty()){
                auto p=pq.top(); pq.pop();
                int pF=p.F; int pS=p.S;
                if(dist[pF]<pS) continue;
                visit[pF]=2;
                for(int i=0; i<(int)ja[pF].size(); i++){
                    auto &e=ja[pF][i];
                    if(e.flow==0) continue;
                    int cdist=pS+(e.cost+d[pF]-d[e.u]);
                    if(cdist<dist[e.u]){
                        if(visit[e.u]==2) return false;
                        pq.push(pair(e.u, cdist));
                        dist[e.u]=cdist; prv[e.u]=pF; prve[e.u]=i;
                        visit[e.u]=1;
                    }
                }
            }
            return visit[T]!=0;
        }

        int augment(){
            int p=T; int min=gmax;
            while(p!=S){
                int pp=prv[p], pe=prve[p];
                int val=ja[pp][pe].flow;
                if(val<min) min=val;
                p=pp;
            }
            p=T;
            while(p!=S){
                int pp=prv[p], pe=prve[p];
                ja[pp][pe].flow-=min;
                ja[p][ja[pp][pe].rid].flow+=min;
                p=pp;
            }
            maxFlow+=min;
            return min;
        }

        bool calSimple() {
            // optional negative cycle check
            /* bool possible=BellmanFord(true);
            if(!possible) return false; */
            while(simple()){
                minCost+=static_cast<long long>(dist[T])*augment();
            }
            return true;
        }

        void updPotential(){
            for(int i=0; i<N; i++){
                if(visit[i]!=0){
                    d[i]+=dist[i]-dist[S];
                }
            }
        }

        bool calWithPotential() {
            // optional negative cycle check
            // bool possible=BellmanFord(false);
            // if(!possible) return false;
            while(dijkstra()){
                int min=dist[T]+d[T]-d[S];
                minCost+=static_cast<long long>(min)*augment();
                updPotential();
            }
            return true;
        }
    };

    int n,m,k,c,d;
    vector<int> a,f;

    void solve(int testNumber, istream& in, ostream& out) {
        in>>n>>m>>k>>c>>d;
        int maxl=n+k, T=n*maxl+1;
        MinCostMaxFlow ans(T+1,0,T);
        a.resize(k+1);
        f.resize(n+1);
        for(int i=1; i<=k; i++){
            in>>a[i];
            f[a[i]]++;
        }
        for(int i=1; i<=n; i++){
            if(f[i]==0) continue;
            ans.addEdge(0,i,f[i],0);
        }
        for(int i=2; i<=n; i++){
            for(int l=0; l<maxl-1; l++){
                ans.addEdge(l*n+i,(l+1)*n+i,k,c);
            }
        }
        for(int i=1; i<=m; i++){
            int a_,b; in>>a_>>b;
            for(int l=0; l<maxl-1; l++){
                for(int p=1; p<=k; p++){
                    if(a_!=1)
                        ans.addEdge(n*l+a_, n*(l+1)+b, 1, d*(2*p-1)+c);
                    if(b!=1)
                        ans.addEdge(n*l+b, n*(l+1)+a_, 1, d*(2*p-1)+c);
                }
            }
        }
        for(int l=1; l<maxl; l++){
            ans.addEdge(l*n+1, T, k, 0);
        }
        ans.convertToArray();
        ans.calWithPotential();
        // ans.calSimple();  // optional
        if(ans.maxFlow!=k){
            out<<"BUG\n";
        } else {
            out<<(int)ans.minCost<<"\n";
        }
    }
};

class InputReader {
public:
    std::istream& in;
    std::stringstream ss;
    InputReader(std::istream& stream) : in(stream) {}
    std::string next() {
        std::string s;
        in>>s;
        return s;
    }
    int nextInt() {
        int v; in>>v; return v;
    }
    long long nextLong() {
        long long v; in>>v; return v;
    }
    double nextDouble() {
        double v; in>>v; return v;
    }
    bool hasMoreTokens() {
        return !in.eof();
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    G g;
    g.solve(1, std::cin, std::cout);
    return 0;
}
